sources.label: Representation Router design model
sources.note: Defines semantic model → ViewSpec → SurfaceSpec → product-owned implementation.

concepts.title: The gap
concepts.summary: ViewSpec could describe one concern-specific representation, but there was no explicit contract for the application surface that coordinates several views, revisions, shared focus, and consequential actions.
concepts.detail: The missing layer was not another visualization type. It was the boundary between concern-specific representations and the human working surface where planning, review, architecture, evidence, or product interaction actually happens.

concepts.title: SurfaceSpec
concepts.summary: Compose ViewSpecs with exact source revisions, shared semantic focus, interface patterns, provenance, success criteria, and explicit action boundaries.
concepts.detail: SurfaceSpec is deliberately not a semantic store or workflow engine. It records how authoritative sources participate in one human experience while leaving domain meaning, persistence, authorization, and external effects with the owning product.

concepts.title: Deterministic builder
concepts.summary: buildSurfaceSpec() validates closed vocabularies, exact source bindings, unique IDs, view roles, and authority-sensitive action contracts.
concepts.detail: Self-review tightened the boundary: surface-local actions cannot carry external write destinations or authority, and read-only actions reject write-like stale/evidence semantics instead of silently normalizing them.

concepts.title: Proving cases
concepts.summary: The contract was exercised against Company Planning, a real DoDAF lifecycle, and a real code-review workflow without importing those domains into SurfaceSpec.
concepts.detail: Domain-specific relations such as implemented-by, verified-by, reviewed-under, or Git changed-file semantics stayed inside concern-specific ViewSpecs. The generic surface coordinates those views rather than absorbing their ontology.

concepts.title: Executable evidence
concepts.summary: CI run 35044053698 successfully executed npm ci and npm test on the exact verified PR head.
concepts.detail: A test file says a check exists. CI configuration says an execution path exists. A successful CI receipt is evidence that the configured suite actually ran and passed. This distinction is now part of the review model.

concepts.title: Merged result
concepts.summary: SurfaceSpec is on main and the repository now has a reusable application-facing composition layer above ViewSpec.
concepts.detail: The technical change is implemented, tested, and merged. The remaining checkpoint is human: whether the resulting representation is actually easier to understand and review than the raw repository artifacts.

architecture.title: Domain / workflow truth
architecture.summary: Company Planning, DoDAF, Git/code, tests, runtime, or the product domain owns meaning and authoritative state.

architecture.title: ViewSpec
architecture.summary: One concern-specific semantic projection plus its representation, interactions, availability, provenance, and success criteria.

architecture.title: SurfaceSpec
architecture.summary: One human working surface coordinating one or more ViewSpecs, source/revision bindings, shared focus, interface patterns, and safe actions.

architecture.title: Product-owned application
architecture.summary: Renderer, final UI behavior, persistence, authorization, workflow effects, and user outcome remain with the consuming product.

architecture.title: Human
architecture.summary: Plans, inspects, edits, reviews, operates, learns, or decides through the working representation.

requirements.title: Compose several concern-specific views
requirements.question: Can one working surface coordinate multiple ViewSpecs without flattening their meaning?

requirements.title: Preserve source and revision authority
requirements.question: Can the surface say exactly which external truth/revision it is showing?

requirements.title: Keep action authority honest
requirements.question: Can UI controls remain read-only/local unless an authoritative write contract is explicitly supplied?

requirements.title: Do not absorb domain semantics
requirements.question: Can Company Planning, DoDAF, and Git/code keep their own ontologies?

requirements.title: Separate checks from executed evidence
requirements.question: Can the review distinguish test definitions, CI configuration, and successful execution?

requirements.title: Keep human acceptance separate
requirements.question: Does green CI stay different from human usefulness, comprehension, or product approval?
